_about: The world's story, for whoever writes the rumors: what happened and happens when, where, and why, in order. Not read by the game (rumors.json and uniques.json are); kept beside them so the timeline editor shows the events the rumors hang on. day: the game's day it happens (0 or less: before the game begins; null: not fixed yet).

places.name: The village
places.about: Where Sera arrives. Human villagers; Sera is not human (her ears show it).

places.name: Where the mist began
places.about: The mist came from here, from the north. Why is not known yet (a branch to write).

places.name: The next village
places.about: Several sections west of C8, on the far side of the river, in the western wilds: the road from the bridge runs west and then north to it. Miyu was here when the mist came. Already under siege.

places.name: The great woods
places.about: Where the village gathered every week until the mist.

places.name: The city
places.about: Not in the game yet. Reached by a road that has to be cleared; the merchants come from it.

events.title: The mist rises in the north
events.about: The mist starts at H5 and spreads slowly outwards. Monsters come out of it.

events.title: Monsters attack the village; Sera arrives
events.about: Sera reaches the village as it is attacked from the mist, and saves it. The elder is here; his granddaughter Miyu is not.

events.title: The next village is under siege
events.about: Across the river the mist has already closed round the next village. Miyu is trapped there.

events.title: The next village falls
events.about: If nobody reaches it within six days of hearing, nobody there is left alive: Miyu is lost.

events.title: The great woods begin to rot
events.about: Left to the mist, something starts moving in the woods.

events.title: Merchants reach the village
events.about: Once a way to the city is cleared, a merchant and his daughter Katrin visit now and then with an escort. Later the escort abandons them and they ask Sera to see them home; if she does not, the same escort kills them on the road (they side with those who distrust Sera). Lost: the trade route, and Katrin, an alchemist who becomes a mage.

characters.name: Sera
characters.about: The player: Sera, a demi-human shrine maiden (a miko), not human. Came from the south-east.

characters.name: The elder
characters.about: The village's chief. Not in the game yet. Miyu's grandfather; gives the rumor to find her.

characters.name: Miyu
characters.about: The elder's granddaughter. Unique: at full intimacy she asks for a book to learn magic (one book, for good).

characters.name: Katrin
characters.about: A wandering merchant's daughter. Not in the game yet. Unique: an alchemist, later a mage.
